metadata.title: Diagnose Integration Test Failure
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Analyze test failure to identify root cause. Use after capturing failure information to determine what needs fixing.

output.description: Root cause identified and categorized with rationale

prerequisites: Captured failure information from previous step
specificActions: Review test failure information from previous step
Validate test expectations match business requirements
Review test data setup (mocks, fixtures, databases)
Distinguish: 'test is wrong' vs 'code is wrong' vs 'setup is wrong'
tools: read_file - Read test and application code
run_terminal_cmd - Check git history: git log --oneline --all --since="2 weeks ago" -- <file>
bestPractices: Distinguish test issue from code issue from infrastructure issue

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Review failure info from previous step
substeps.description: Read captured failure information from memory
actions: Understand error messages and stack traces

substeps.name: Validate test expectations
substeps.description: Check if test expectations match requirements
actions: Validate test expectations against business requirements

substeps.name: Review test data setup
substeps.description: Check test data, mocks, and fixtures

substeps.name: Examine recent code changes
substeps.description: Look at recent changes that might have caused failure
actions: Examine recent code changes using git log
Check if recent changes broke the test

substeps.name: Categorize root cause
actions: Categorize root cause: Test Issue, Code Issue, or Infrastructure

substeps.name: Document decision rationale
substeps.description: Document reasoning for root cause determination
actions: Write root cause and fix decision to memory

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: Do modified process files conform to type definitions? (Principle 7 - see `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md`)
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Review failure → Validate expectations → Check assertions → Review data → Check changes → Check infrastructure → Categorize → Document

fields: Information Produced: Root cause category, analysis results
Decisions Made: What needs to be fixed and why

requiredFiles: Previous step memory with failure info
